properties.evidence: Read from `regions.rs:170`: `design_regions` loops over every REGION_SEED_TYPE node — 1 Project + 108 Components on this design — and calls `self.scope_region(&n.node_id, depth)?` inside the loop, so the region walk is rebuilt from scratch per seed rather than built once and interrogated. Measured on the wire 2026-09-11: a single scoped walk (`detect_gaps` with `scope` and `depth: 1`) costs 5,173 ms; 109 of those is ~545 s, which accounts for the observed >300 s with no other cause needed. The three rollups it calls first — detect_gaps 3,881 ms, open_defects via detect_defects 10,711 ms, claims 5,143 ms — are each paid ONCE and together are ~20 s, so they are not the story.
